name: AI Sales Rep Follow-Up Auditor regarding the pending payment recovery

parameters.content:
## GoHighLevel & Stripe Automated Sales Operations Auditor

### How it works

Triggers on an hourly schedule to fetch opportunities from GoHighLevel and verify their monetary value.
Deduplicates opportunities against existing logs stored in a Google Sheet.
Collects historical conversations, tasks, and Stripe billing records for the associated contact.
Prepares contextual data and prompts a Gemini-powered AI agent to evaluate follow-up urgency and messaging.
Verifies if alert criteria are met, then formats and posts a notification to Slack.
Records the dispatched Slack alert back into Google Sheets for tracking.

### Setup steps

- - [ ] Connect GoHighLevel credentials for opportunity, conversation, and task retrieval.
- - [ ] Connect Stripe API credentials to retrieve customer and charge details.
- - [ ] Configure Google Gemini AI credentials in the LangChain chat model node.
- - [ ] Connect Google Sheets OAuth credentials and select the appropriate tracking spreadsheet.
- - [ ] Configure Slack credentials and specify the destination channel for alerts.

### Customization

Adjust the monetary threshold in the filter node or fine-tune prompt instructions and JSON schema inside the AI agent to fit specific sales follow-up criteria.

@[youtube](Fp2L7VmWtkk)

## Trigger and filter opportunities

Pulls GoHighLevel opportunities on an hourly schedule and filters them based on monetary value.

## Identify unique opportunities

Cross-references opportunities against Google Sheets history to prevent duplicate handling.

## Retrieve contact interactions

Fetches communication threads, conversation history, and contact tasks from GoHighLevel.

## Fetch Stripe customer charges

Retrieves customer records and payment charge history directly from Stripe.

## Generate AI follow-up insights

Compiles collected CRM and financial context to evaluate deal urgency and suggest action via Gemini.

## Filter and format alerts

Checks whether an alert is necessary based on AI severity output and formats the Slack payload.

## Dispatch and log alerts

Sends the generated alert notification to Slack and appends a record to Google Sheets.

options.systemMessage:
You are a Sales Operations auditor. Every morning you review ONE closed-won deal whose payment is not yet fully received, and decide whether the sales rep is following up properly or the deal is quietly slipping.

INPUT
You get a JSON "context" with: deal, contact, payment, communication, tasks, thresholds and flags. Every number and flag was computed by code. Treat them as FACT. Never recompute, never invent dates, amounts, invoice numbers or links. If something is null, say "no data".

DEFINITIONS
- "Rep touch" = a human-sent outbound message or call. Automated workflow/campaign messages do NOT count.
- payment.outstanding = deal value minus money received since the deal was closed.

FLAGS -> SCENARIO -> MINIMUM SEVERITY
- PAID_IN_FULL: scenario PAID, alert_needed=false, severity none. Stop here.
- CUSTOMER_REPLIED_UNANSWERED: scenario CUSTOMER_WAITING. high; critical if hours_since_last_customer_message > 24.
- NO_FOLLOW_UP_SINCE_CLOSE: scenario NO_FOLLOW_UP. high; critical if PAYMENT_OVERDUE_ESCALATE is also present.
- STALE_FOLLOW_UP: scenario STALE_FOLLOW_UP. medium; high if TASK_OVERDUE is also present.
- TASK_OVERDUE: scenario TASK_OVERDUE. medium; high if there are zero rep touches since close.
- NO_OPEN_TASK (payment still pending): scenario NO_NEXT_STEP. medium.
- NO_OWNER_ASSIGNED: scenario NO_OWNER. medium; high if NO_FOLLOW_UP_SINCE_CLOSE is also present.
- PARTIAL_PAYMENT: scenario PARTIAL_PAYMENT. medium minimum; state the remaining amount.
- Only WITHIN_FIRST_TOUCH_SLA present, an open task that is not overdue, and an owner assigned: scenario ON_TRACK, alert_needed=false, severity none.
- Several flags: use the most severe one as "scenario", raise severity one level if three or more problem flags stack, and mention the others in evidence.
- PAYMENT_OVERDUE_ESCALATE: set escalate_to_manager=true. Also set it true for any critical severity.

alert_needed = true for severity low, medium, high or critical. false only for PAID and ON_TRACK.

OUTPUT FIELDS
- headline: max 15 words, plain language, no jargon.
- evidence: 2 to 4 strings, each with concrete facts from the context (dates, hours, amounts, task titles).
- recommended_action: ONE imperative sentence addressed to the sales rep, with a deadline (e.g. "Call the client today before 5 PM and share the payment link").
- suggested_followup_message: a short, polite message the rep can send to the customer on WhatsApp or email. Mention the signed agreement and the outstanding amount, give one clear next step. Use [payment link] as a placeholder. Max 60 words. Empty string if alert_needed=false.

Return ONLY the JSON object that matches the schema. No markdown, no commentary.

parameters.jsonSchemaExample:
{
  "alert_needed": true,
  "severity": "high",
  "scenario": "NO_FOLLOW_UP",
  "headline": "Deal closed 3 days ago, no rep contact and no payment yet",
  "evidence": [
    "Deal value USD 3500, USD 0 received since close on 12 Oct",
    "0 rep touches since close; only automated messages sent",
    "Payment task was due 13 Oct and is still open"
  ],
  "recommended_action": "Call the client today before 5 PM, share the payment link and log the outcome in GHL.",
  "suggested_followup_message": "Hi, thanks again for signing the agreement. The first payment of USD 3500 is still pending - here is the payment link: [payment link]. Could you confirm when it will be completed? Happy to help if you hit any issue.",
  "escalate_to_manager": false
}

assignments.name: amount_line
assignments.value: ={{ (c => c.currency.toUpperCase() + ' ' + c.expected + ' expected  |  ' + c.paid_since_close + ' received  |  ' + c.outstanding + ' outstanding')($('Compile Follow-Up Context').item.json.context.payment) }}
